newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT says entitled to 55.9 pct of TNT.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT says entitled to 55.9 pct of TNT.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Friday it is now entitled to 55.9 percent of the issued ordinary shares of TNT and 40.4 percent of the issued converting preference shares of TNT.

KPN (Australia) will pay accepting shareholders the A$2.45 per share cash for their shares within five business days of receipt of their valid acceptance. KPN's ordinary and converting preference offers are due to close on December 12, 1996. The Dutch firm said its bid was now free of all conditions, including the 90 percent acceptance conditino in the early October offer documents.
KPN encourages all TNT shareholders who have not yet accepted its offers to do so as soon as possible, the company said.
